ogretici.hosgeldinMetin: I'll walk you through the game step by step. This hand was dealt specially for you — you can close the tutorial any time.
ogretici.turMetin: A game runs for 16 rounds. The current round shows here, and the number beside it is your turn timer.
ogretici.sartMetin: Every round has its own opening requirement, shown here. This round it's: 2 × three-tile set.
ogretici.sartEk: A set = the same number in different colours. The whole requirement goes down in one move — no less, no more.
ogretici.istakaMetin: Your tiles live here. Drag them to rearrange; tiles you place side by side count as one group.
ogretici.atMetin: After opening you end your turn by discarding. Drag a tile you don't need onto the pile in the middle.
ogretici.atEk: Discarding a tile that could be played onto a set on the table costs you 50 points — those are the ones marked orange in your rack.
ogretici.rakiplerMetin: The other players take their turns now. One of them will open using a joker — and you'll be able to take that joker.
ogretici.calmaBekleMetin: You can claim a discarded tile even when it isn't your turn. We're waiting for someone to discard.
ogretici.acMetin: You already hold two three-tile sets. First press SORT SETS on the left so your tiles split into groups. Then TAP EACH of those six tiles one by one (selected tiles lift up), and finally press OPEN.
ogretici.acEk: This round select exactly THREE + THREE tiles. A four-tile set won't be accepted: the requirement goes down whole — no less, no more.
ogretici.cekMetin: Every turn starts with a draw. Grab a tile from the deck in the middle and drop it wherever you like on your rack.
ogretici.cekEk: You can also take from the discard pile instead — if the top tile was discarded by the player on your left, it costs you nothing.
ogretici.indirMetin: Once you've met the round's requirement it no longer applies: you can lay down as many extra sets and runs as you like. The joker you just took can complete one — select the tiles and press LAY DOWN. Then discard a tile to end your turn.
ogretici.indirEk: A joker stands in for any tile. If you don't hold a meld, press NEXT to move on; pairs are only the requirement for round 15, after that play continues with sets and runs.
ogretici.isleMetin: One full turn after you open, you can add tiles to sets on the table — your own and other players'.
ogretici.isleEk: Press it without selecting anything and every usable tile goes; the sets you built yourself and the joker are kept back.
ogretici.okeyAlMetin: If a joker sits in a set on the table and you hold the tile it stands for, you can take the joker into your rack.
ogretici.okeyAlEk: To take a joker out of a set you must complete that set to all four colours. If you haven't opened yet and the joker lets you meet the requirement, you can take it and open in the same move — but you must use it in that opening; you can't keep it in your rack.
ogretici.istiyorumMetin: A player whose turn it isn't can still claim a discarded tile. Press this to put in a claim.
ogretici.istiyorumEk: The cost: one penalty tile from the deck plus 5 points. The tile goes to the highest-priority claimant, starting from the discarder's right. A claim is binding.
ogretici.ciftimVarMetin: Only active in the pairs round (round 15). If the exact twin of the discarded tile is in your rack, this button lights up and the tile is yours immediately.
ogretici.ciftimVarEk: This isn't a claim, it's the move itself: it waits for no one and beats seat priority. Once you've laid down four pairs the right closes and play continues with sets and runs.
ogretici.bittiMetin: That's the whole game. The table carries on as normal practice from here — take as long as you like.
lobi.ogreticiIpucu: New to the game? Play a guided hand in practice mode.
ogretici.soruMetin: We'll walk you through a specially dealt hand step by step: opening, playing tiles, taking a joker and stealing. It takes a few minutes and you can close it any time.
ogretici.calmaSonucMetin: The claim resolves once the player in turn moves. If the tile comes to you, a penalty tile comes with it.
ogretici.calmaSonucEk: The tile goes to the highest-priority claimant, starting from the discarder's right — if someone ahead of you claimed it, it's theirs.
